descriptionChirho: A person from the region of Samaria, used as a proper noun / gentilic noun. All three clusters represent the same referent — a Samaritan — varying only by grammatical number (singular vs. plural) and case (nominative, genitive, dative). Multilingual evidence is uniformly consistent: Spanish 'samaritano' / 'de Samaritôn' (Samaritan / of Samaritans), Hindi 'सामरी' / 'सामरियों के' (Samaritan / of the Samaritans), Arabic 'سامِرِيّ' / 'السّامِرِيّينَ' (Samaritan / the Samaritans), Korean '사마리아인' / '사마리아 사람들' (Samaritan / Samaritan people), Swahili 'Msamaria' / 'Wasamaria' (Samaritan / Samaritans, using the standard M-/Wa- class 1/2 noun prefix pattern).
